title: Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry
abstract: arXiv:2611.13517v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate inertial odometry is critical for autonomous systems but suffers from unbounded drift caused by the integration of sensor noise and biases. In approaches such as TLIO, neural pseudo-measurements are trained independently of their downstream filter. This paper introduces Differentiable Filtering for Inertial Odometry (DFIO), a learning framework that embeds the update stages of an error-state Kalman filter directly into a computational graph. Following standalone pre-training, DFIO jointly optimizes the displacement and covariance output heads using posterior-position supervision through differentiable measurement updates. The proposed system is validated on public pedestrian motion datasets featuring both calibrated and uncalibrated inertial measurements. translated_title: 面向惯性里程计的可微分滤波
translated_abstract: 精确的惯性里程计对自主系统至关重要，但由于传感器噪声和偏置的积分会导致无界漂移。在TLIO等现有方法中，神经伪测量网络是独立于下游滤波器进行训练的。本文提出了DFIO（面向惯性里程计的可微分滤波），这是一种学习框架，将误差状态卡尔曼滤波器的更新阶段直接嵌入到计算图中。在完成独立预训练后，DFIO通过可微分测量更新，利用后验位置监督联合优化位移和协方差输出头。该系统在包含标定与未标定惯性测量数据的公开行人运动数据集上进行了验证。行人数据集上的实验结果表明，相对于TLIO基线，DFIO将平均绝对平移误差和一秒相对平移误差分别降低了13.2%和39.6%。
tldr: 本文提出DFIO框架，将误差状态卡尔曼滤波器的测量更新阶段嵌入计算图实现端到端可微分训练，联合优化位移与协方差输出头，使行人惯性里程计的平均绝对平移误差和一秒相对平移误差分别降低13.2%和39.6%。
